description: FlashAttention ROCm CK backend experiment for the local gfx1151 stack
divergence_notes: Uses the ROCm FlashAttention main_perf branch because the documented AMD CK and Triton backend paths live there.
Builds the CK extension with FLASH_ATTENTION_TRITON_AMD_ENABLE=FALSE, FLASH_ATTENTION_SKIP_CUDA_BUILD=FALSE, and GPU_ARCHS=gfx1151.
Carries the setup.py portion of ROCm/flash-attention branch matthias.gfx1151_ck commit 561341f7e0913fb7dd12c81d9e68501a5a847220 so CK accepts gfx1151 and codegen targets gfx11.

Checks out csrc/composable_kernel at commit 03ce21ddcbb75c5ac8630628a913d0b2ced4979a because that is the matching CK gitlink from the matthias.gfx1151_ck branch and contains gfx11 FMHA codegen factories.

Builds a bounded d32+d256 CK surface with FLASH_ATTENTION_CK_GENERATORS=fwd,fwd_splitkv, FLASH_ATTENTION_CK_FILTER='*fp16*nbias_nmask*ndropout*', OPT_DIM=32,256, and FLASH_ATTENTION_CK_NO_BWD_KVCACHE_API=TRUE so direct qkvpacked, variable-length, and paged-KV split-KV smokes can validate CK without compiling unused backward, fwd_kvcache, dtype, mask, or dropout variants.
Uses the revised CK generator flow by keeping the bounded CK filter only on plain fwd generation because the same filter excludes required gfx11 paged-KV split-KV combine kernels at OPT_DIM=256.
Clears generated build/ FMHA output before CK codegen runs so reused srcdirs cannot leak stale fmha_*wd translation units into later builds.
Adapts the FlashAttention CK forward wrapper to the newer CK fmha_fwd_args layout by filling no-scale/no-sink block-scale and descale fields with zero/null values.

Value-initializes fmha_fwd_splitkv_args and sets sink_ptr=nullptr, sink_size=0, and logits_soft_cap=0.0f in the varlen and kvcache split-KV argument builders, backporting the split-KV hunks of ROCm/flash-attention 8afc617a (#2363) plus the logits_soft_cap line from c661198a; without them CK 03ce21dd reads uninitialized host stack as sink_ptr and the paged-KV varlen path faults the GPU.
Compiles the paged-KV variable-length split-KV branch only when FLASH_ATTENTION_CK_HAS_SPLITKV is defined by the setup patch.

Extends the public Python flash_attn_varlen_func wrapper to accept the vLLM-shaped CK varlen keyword surface, derive cu_seqlens_k from seqused_k when needed, pass seqused_k and leftpad_k through to CK, copy into an explicit out tensor, tolerate validated all-ones descales and num_splits=0, and reject unsupported scheduler metadata, nontrivial descales, split controls, return_softmax_lse=True, or s_aux values with clear errors.

Uses repo-owned python-triton-gfx1151 and python-pytorch-opt-rocm-gfx1151 instead of letting setup.py install bundled or PyPI runtime pieces. AITER is not a build or runtime input on the CK path: setup.py installs third_party/aiter only on its Triton branch (patch 0001 skips that too), and flash_attn imports aiter only when FLASH_ATTENTION_TRITON_AMD_ENABLE=TRUE, so python-amd-aiter-gfx1151 is an optdepend for that Triton AMD path.
update_notes: Recheck the ROCm FlashAttention main_perf branch and CK-tile tags before bumping this package.

Keep direct flash_attn CK build/import, qkvpacked, variable-length, and direct paged-KV smokes as the first validation gate before any engine integration scenario; the current installed 2.8.4-10 direct gate passed on 2026-04-23, while the Qwen3.5 vLLM CK consumer remains blocked deeper in CK paged-KV.
Keep the Triton AMD smoke explicit because runtime backend selection still depends on FLASH_ATTENTION_TRITON_AMD_ENABLE.
Treat FLASH_ATTENTION_TRITON_AMD_AUTOTUNE=TRUE as a performance follow-up, not part of the initial correctness gate.

On 2026-05-26, bump pkgrel to 12 for delivery of the CK extension rebuild against python-pytorch-opt-rocm-gfx1151 2.12.0-2 from ROCm/pytorch release/2.12 commit 26872debb4452ea6dc898288618a15595e2317d9.
On 2026-06-15, bump pkgrel to 14 for the c7badbdf runtime-base rebuild so FlashAttention supersedes the unmerged ab32a1f/pkgrel-13 host-drift artifact.

On 2026-09-25, bump pkgrel to 15 for the W2A rebuild against python-pytorch-opt-rocm-gfx1151 2.12.0-5 and the Python 3.14 foundation, and move python-amd-aiter-gfx1151 from depends to optdepends because the CK build path does not use AITER.

On 2026-09-25, bump pkgrel to 16 for patch 0010, which initializes the CK split-KV forward args so the paged-KV varlen path no longer passes uninitialized sink_ptr, sink_size, and logits_soft_cap to CK. Drop 0007 and 0010 once the package moves to a FlashAttention ref that contains 8afc617a.
